caption: The drawing features a single sculptural object of an eagle rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with detailed feather textures and a prominent hooked beak. The eagle is perched on top of a stylized rock base, which sits on a rectangular plinth. The wings of the eagle are spread wide, showing the intricate layering and veining of the feathers. The bird's talons grasp the rocky structure beneath it. The background is a uniform, muted blue with a soft gradient effect, providing contrast to the detailed depiction of the pale eagle sculpture in the foreground. The composition is centered, and the entire eagle, including its wings and base, is fully visible within the frame.
title: Wooden Eagle
